1. (Currently amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall __and protruding from the wall less than three inches__, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan.

2. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __sixteen inches__ on center.

3. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced [[about]] __twenty-four inches__ on center.

4. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad.

5. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __in a front cover of the housing__.

7. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

11. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover.

13. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __and the housing is disposed between the pair of studs of the load-bearing wall__.

15. (Currently amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements; and a ventilation grill __configured to cover the opening__.

17. (Currently amended) A cooling system, comprising: in a [[means for mounting within a structure wall, a means for evaporatively cooling an indoor area]] __housing disposed between a pair of studs of a structure wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation__.

18. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling between wall studs spaced about sixteen inches on center]] __the pair of studs are spaced sixteen inches on center__.

19. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF)]] __the structure wall is constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF)__.

20. (Currently amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein [[the means for enclosing protrudes from the wall less than three inches]] __the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches__.
